With built-up areas ranging from approximately 5,119 to 9,991 sq. ft., these homes will offer expansive living spaces, including open-plan kitchens, large bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, and stylish interiors that exude sophistication. Buying a Property in Golf Place Terraces

Golf Place Terraces Dubai properties present an exceptional selection of 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas for sale, designed to offer luxury and tranquility within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate. With prices starting from AED 7.25M, these villas provide a rare opportunity to own a home in one of Dubai's most sought-after communities. For those seeking premium properties for sale in Dubai, Golf Place Terraces is an ideal choice, blending modern design with a serene environment.

These Golf Place Terraces investment opportunities are made even more attractive with a flexible payment plan tailored to suit investors and homebuyers. Buyers can secure their villa with just a 10% down payment, followed by 40% payable during the construction phase, 10% on completion, and the remaining 40% post-completion.
